title: ScholarEvolve turns research papers into agent code without retraining
teaser: Researchers at the University of California, Santa Barbara, and Microsoft have built ScholarEvolve, a framework that turns findings from research papers into changes to an AI agent’s supporting code without retraining its underlying model. Tested on AppWorld and tau-Bench Telecom, it improved Qwen3.5-27B and GPT-5.4-mini on every reported measure. The approach shifts agent improvement from reacting to failures the system has already encountered to looking for techniques in published research—but it also raises a practical question: how much trust should teams place in code assembled from papers and repositories?
